categories.title: Backend
categories.summary: Modular monoliths with strict separation between routes, services and data access. Routes hold no business logic. Services own the transaction boundary. Data access never commits.

categories.title: Frontend
categories.summary: Product interfaces built on a documented component and data-fetching layer, so the tenth screen costs what the second one did.

categories.title: Data and infrastructure
categories.summary: Everything runs in Docker locally and in production. Migrations are reviewed like code, because they are the only part you cannot roll back casually.

categories.title: Reliability
categories.summary: Background work, caching and observability treated as part of the feature, not as something added after the first incident.

categories.title: Quality
categories.summary: Tests where they earn their keep, documentation that carries a date stamp, and a checker that fails the commit when the two disagree.

categories.title: AI in production
categories.summary: Models used where they change what a product can do, and AI tooling used to ship more without shipping worse.
